control_ball_input: RGB camera estimated ball position and velocity; no ground truth ball targeting
proprioception: joint state, IMU, support contacts and model-based robot COM are allowed
required_sequence: prepare posture before first physical interception
real hand or body interception, without requiring a prior body impact
real bilateral grounded stable hold2s; no fall, goal, lift or numerical overflow
current_subproblem: user-requested exploratory full-goal-width random shots with lateral motion and anticipatory ground capture
next_subproblems: independent random launch and goal target
balanced full goal coverage at 0.3 to 1.0 m/s
forbidden_shortcuts: per-step root or joint state writes
claim_limit: finite independent testing can establish a measured operating range, not perfection on every possible shot
expand_before_narrow_gate_passed: Explicitly requested by user; exploratory training, not acceptance
